rationale: The pain is genuine and well-documented — plaintext .env secrets leaking through VPS/Docker/GitHub Actions setups is an endemic, high-severity problem with real financial consequences. However, the scoring analysis correctly identifies that no buildable, autonomous product exists here for this factory: secrets management requires live infrastructure integration, per-customer setup work, and ongoing technical support that Claude + Stripe cannot replace. The opportunity is better treated as a validated pain signal pointing toward an affiliate/referral play (e.g., a free guide funnelling to Doppler or Infisical) than as a promotable experiment. Rejecting to prevent wasted build cycles; pain evidence is noted for reuse in content/affiliate strategies.
